interpretation: Frozen planar fixed-color counterexamples to inferring global SAT from nonempty local propagation. All original simple cycles are independently enumerated at the required gap snapshots; every cycle retains all unary supports. Complete elimination remains responsible for exact final verdicts. Complete original-edge solution preservation is checked for both SAT controls, with vacuous preservation on UNSAT contexts. No universal graph coverage or newly implemented wheel propagator is claimed.
